name: Robust Control
description: Mathematical Preliminaries: vector, matrix, signals and systems, SVD; Feedback interconnection, Well-posedness and Internal stability; Coprime factorization and stabilizing controllers; Uncertainty representations: Parametric, non-parametric, Structured and Unstructured; Uncertain polynomials , Kharitonov's result; Stability of polytope of polynomials; Sensitivity and complementary sensitivity, Linear fractional transformation (LFT) and Robust Stability; LMI and Algebraic Riccati Equation and Solution; H-2 and H-{infinity} control problems ; mu-Synthesis
